title: Liquidation Level Scenario — Live Walkthrough

edits.reason: Intro bullet explicitly names a THREE-cluster 'complete liquidity map': 'Real example: 50x long liq at $6,307; 25x long liq at $6,180; short clusters at $6,346 = complete liquidity map.' The def draws the 50x (gold ladder @81-83) and the short cluster (pink @98) but the 25x long liq is named yet never drawn. yAxis 84 is inside the band (~80-107), gold to match the other long-liq cluster, sitting just above the 50x ladder where the text places it ($6,180 vs $6,307). The intro is the map-illustration slot, so drawing all three named clusters fits. Note: 84 sits between the gold ladder top (83) and the teal Range Low/DBS line (85) — tight but legible as the third rung of the long-liq ladder.

The lesson's causal chain begins at the Range Low and the chart never draws it. Lesson bullets: 'Price ran below Range Low (deviation/liquidity pool) → hit 50x long liquidation zone → immediate bounce' and 'Rule of Fives triggered at Range Low before the move → anticipated the deviation before plotting liquidation levels.' Range Low is the origin of the whole 'WHY' story this chart illustrates, yet only the 25x Short Liq+SSR @95 and the gold 50x ladder are drawn. yAxis 85 is inside the band (~81-115), sits cleanly above the gold ladder (83), and is teal to match the identical Range Low @85 (teal) used in both the introChart and the quiz.chart — consistent across the chapter.

notes: REJECTED the auditor's lessonChart '25x Long Liq Zone' @84 (low-confidence) gap. The text does teach a second bounce ('Then hit 25x long liquidation zone → another bounce from DBS zone alignment'), but @84 would wedge a third line into a 2-unit pocket already occupied by the proposed Range Low @85 and the existing gold 50x ladder @81-83. On the lessonChart (the worked-trade slot) that crowding hurts clarity more than the level teaches; the 50x ladder + Range Low already carry the long-side liquidation story. All proposed yAxis values verified inside their bands; no dataIndex changes proposed.
